items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Eli Oversinger was down at Victor and he comes in with, he told me, 'The way I do it...'

ctx.x: Well, anyway, he gets his band together and he's

out. Tommy's got his band out first, you know, and he comes in occasionally with Eli Oversinger was down at Victor and he comes in with, he told me, "The way I do it, I come back in with about 30 arrangements and make them in maybe one or two settings."
: Because the band has already been playing them.
